title: Load supported HumbleSudoku from localhost web helper
summary: Make the web viewer's supported-app HumbleSudoku click path functional on localhost by loading the adjacent local HumbleSudoku bundle through a safe allowlisted helper that can generate the bundle when it is missing.
acceptance_criteria: Running the HumbleStudio web viewer through the local preview helper exposes a localhost endpoint for the supported HumbleSudoku export.
Clicking HumbleSudoku in the supported-app catalog on localhost attempts the local helper before falling back to the existing raw GitHub URL behavior.
The localhost helper is allowlisted to HumbleSudoku and the known `Scripts/generate_humble_studio_config.py --bundle` export command instead of accepting arbitrary app ids or commands.
The helper returns existing exports without regenerating them and can generate a missing export through the allowlisted command.
The static `index.html` fallback and supported-app URL path remain available when the helper is not running.

evidence.note: Local preview helper tests cover existing export reuse, missing export generation, unknown app rejection, missing repository reporting, and API route parsing.
A running localhost preview helper returned the real HumbleSudoku bundle endpoint with `X-HumbleStudio-Local-Export: 1`, `X-HumbleStudio-App-Id: humble-sudoku`, and `X-HumbleStudio-Generated: 0`.
The web loader changes for localhost supported-app loading are syntactically valid.
The web fallback integrity check now also verifies the localhost helper contract fragments.
The HS-0092 ticket JSON stayed valid before schema validation.
The repo status JSON stayed valid after recording the localhost helper slice.
The repo-native HS ticket surface validates with HS-0092 solved.
The local repo contract still validates against the shared HumbleControl-owned standard.
Workflow-only local checks passed for tickets, contract, script compilation, web fallback, and diff hygiene.
Repo workflow scripts and the new localhost helper test script compile.
Strict doctor is still expected to report the active topic-branch freshness gate until this branch is promoted.

trigger.source_ref: Jan asked to focus mainly on functionality after saying localhost clicks on HumbleSudoku should show HumbleSudoku and create missing files when needed.

agent_notes: This is a localhost helper for HumbleStudio's own local workflow, not a production web server.
Only HumbleSudoku is allowlisted in this slice. MyVltavaRun and HumbleControl still use the existing URL path until they get verified local export contracts.
The helper uses an identity header so the browser can distinguish the real helper from a generic static server returning a fallback page.
The live localhost check used the existing HumbleSudoku bundle and therefore did not regenerate or mutate the adjacent HumbleSudoku repository.
